reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the research question's constraints by proposing a lightweight Al-modified TaNbVTi-based alloy, specifies a clear mechanism (boron segregation/precipitates impeding high-temperature dislocation motion and grain boundary sliding), and provides a testable falsification experiment with a defined baseline and measurable outcome. Hypothesis B largely restates the cited Wang et al. result on MoNbTaW without extending it to a lightweight system, failing to address the density limitation required for jet-turbine applications.
